analysis_md:
利用求导公式可得

$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{y}{x^2}f_1'+\frac{1}{y}f_2',\quad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{1}{x}f_1'-\frac{x}{y^2}f_2',$

所以 $x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}-y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-2\left(f_1'\frac{y}{x}-f_2'\frac{x}{y}\right)$

设 $z=f(\frac yx,\frac xy)$，求 $xz_x-yz_y$。 $2\frac yx f_1'-2\frac xy f_2'$ $-\frac yx f_1'+\frac xy f_2'$ $-2\frac yx f_1'+2\frac xy f_2'$ $-2\frac yx f_1'-2\frac xy f_2'$ 利用求导公式可得

$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{y}{x^2}f_1'+\frac{1}{y}f_2',\quad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{1}{x}f_1'-\frac{x}{y^2}f_2',$

所以 $x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}-y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-2\left(f_1'\frac{y}{x}-f_2'\frac{x}{y}\right)$
